title: Metal Text Pipeline Rung Decision Plan
description: A structured record of the rung choice (Rung 1: Vello+Parley on wgpu / Rung 2: wgpu directly / Rung 3: pure objc2-metal) for a custom 2D vector + text surface, plus the justification and pacing/CI facts scripts/rung_decision_audit.mjs checks against this skill's Failure Modes and Anti-Patterns.

chosenRung.description: 1 = Vello+Parley on wgpu (default). 2 = wgpu directly. 3 = pure objc2 + objc2-metal, hand-written MSL.

surfaceKind.description: What the surface actually renders. Rung 3 for '2d-vector-text' means owning the vector rasterizer yourself.

namedConstraintForLowerRung.description: The SPECIFIC Metal feature or hard budget (e.g. 'tile shaders/imageblocks', 'shared MTLCommandQueue with existing Obj-C code', 'sub-100us frame budget') that forces dropping below Rung 1. Null if none named.

measuredRung1Miss.description: True only if the Rung-1 (Vello+Parley) version was actually built and measured missing the named constraint/budget — not assumed.

promotionFrameRateRequested.description: True if the 120Hz ProMotion cadence is explicitly requested (Rung 3: CADisplayLink.preferredFrameRateRange + CAMetalLayer.displaySyncEnabled; Rung 1/2: relies on PresentMode::AutoVsync, which still requires redrawEveryFrame).

redrawEveryFrame.description: True if the event loop requests a redraw every frame while animating, rather than only on input. False caps the effective frame rate regardless of rung.

glyphSource.description: 'parley' = Rung 1 shaping+GPU raster. 'hand-atlas' = Rung 3 CPU-rasterized glyph atlas fed by a real shaper. 'bitmap-font' = fixed bitmap font (always an anti-pattern).

tripleBuffered.description: True if per-frame uniform/vertex buffers are triple-buffered with a completion-handler semaphore. Only meaningful at Rung 3; wgpu (Rung 1/2) handles this internally.

keptOutOfLinuxCI.description: True if this Apple-GPU-specific pipeline (wgpu Metal backend selection, or objc2/objc2-metal at Rung 3) is gated out of the default Linux CI test matrix.
